personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect every coin, gem, relic, key and heart, open every locked door, and finish the level with the time bonus.
personas.style: Explores systematically with goto macros and single steps, checks the map after each pickup, and records which tiles remain. Finishes the level only after the map is empty of items it can reach.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit, doors, gates and levers out of the intended order, and try to get outcomes early (finish without keys, open gates from the wrong side, dash through solid tiles, use Shift at 0 and just after a dash).
personas.style: Tries dashes into walls and closed doors, stands on levers and presses use repeatedly, walks into gates and locked doors with and without keys, and tests the exit before collecting everything.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing around transitions: pause or restart while collecting, getting hit, or finishing; press several keys in one tick; spam input during dialogs.
personas.style: Sends combined tokens such as pause+left, dash-right+up, use+enter and down+right. Presses Escape and P repeatedly, clicks dialog buttons mid-walk, and restarts from the pause menu right after a hit or a dash.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each stated rule literally, including the starting position, the 300 timer, 3 lives, the 4-tick invulnerability and the 6-tick dash recharge.
personas.style: Plays slowly, reads every HUD value after every tick, compares it with the sentence in the document, and reports any wording that the game does not match.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins and timers to their limits and check every amount: score floor at 0, cap at 999,999, 5-life cap with heart-as-500, spike penalty of 500, and time bonus of 10 per tick.
personas.style: Hits spikes at low scores, stacks hearts at 5 lives, collects relics and gems to test score growth, lets the timer run down to 0 and checks the life loss and reset, and compares the HUD text with state at each step.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, Victory) and check what each shows and which buttons can be clicked.
personas.style: Triggers each dialog, inspects its text and buttons in the UI list, clicks every visible button including Resume, Restart level, Finish, Retry and Play again, and verifies no button is covered by another element.

checks.rule: The game raises no runtime errors.
Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
Lives stay between 0 and the maximum of 5.
Coins are between 0 and 5 and never exceed the coins in the level.
Keys never go below zero.
The timer is between 0 and 300.
The timer drops by exactly 1 at the end of every running tick (except when it expires and resets).
A dash sets the recharge to 6 and it counts down to 5 at the end of that running tick.
While the recharge is above 0, Shift plus arrow is an ordinary step and does not dash.
The dash recharge counts down by 1 at the end of every running tick.
The player makes at most one move per tick: a step of one tile or a dash of up to two tiles in a straight line.
checks.expect: (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y) && abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2

checks.rule: The player never ends a tick on a wall, a closed gate or a locked door.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D' && (tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '=' || cur.state.gateOpen)

checks.rule: Enemies move at most one tile per tick and stay on non-wall tiles.
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1 && tile(cur, e.x, e.y) != '#')

checks.rule: Spikes cost one life and 500 points, and the score never goes below 0.
Touching an enemy costs exactly one life and no points.
Enemies cannot hurt the player during the tick of reappearing or the next 4 ticks.
After losing a life the player reappears at (1,1) and keeps all collected items and keys.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == 1 && cur.state.player.y == 1 && cur.state.keys >= prev.state.keys && cur.state.score >= prev.state.score - 500

checks.rule: The game is over exactly when lives reach 0, and never while lives are above 0 in play.
At 0 lives the Game over dialog appears with a Retry button.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Game over')) && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-retry' && u.visible)

checks.rule: With no dialog or menu open, no dialog is visible and the game is playing.
Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
While paused nothing moves: player, enemies, timer, dash recharge and toasts stay the same.
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.enemies == prev.state.enemies && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast

checks.rule: When pausing, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick.
checks.expect: cur.state.player == prev.state.player && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock

checks.rule: Score only drops because of spikes or a restart; items never reduce it.
Collected items never come back except on a restart.
checks.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics

checks.rule: With 5 lives a heart gives +500 score instead of a life.
Restart level puts the level back to its start: score 0, 3 lives, all items back, timer 300, and the game is running.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: The level is completed only by stepping onto the exit, and the Level complete dialog shows the time bonus of 10 per tick left.
The HUD always shows the current score (below 1,000), lives, keys, coins, time and dash status.
checks.expect: (cur.state.score >= 1000 || num(cur.hud.score) == cur.state.score) && num(cur.hud.lives) == cur.state.lives && num(cur.hud.keys) == cur.state.keys && num(cur.hud.coins) == cur.state.coins && num(cur.hud.time) == cur.state.timeLeft

checks.rule: The dash HUD shows Dash ready at 0 and Dash n otherwise, where n is the recharge left.

value.notes: Round 1 had no prior notes or coverage. Photographer focus: open each dialog and menu, read its text and buttons, click every visible button, and check that none is covered (the UI top flag). The map layout is not known yet, so early plans use short walks and pause/resume/restart cycles. Watch whether the pause menu freezes the timer, dash recharge and toasts, and whether Resume restores the same state. Later rounds should try reaching Level complete, Game over and Victory, which needs the map and enemy timing from the first round's tiles output.

Pause on the same tick as a move and dash, then resume with Enter and Escape; check the rest of the tick's input is ignored.
Walk toward enemies and hazards to trigger hit and respawn, then open pause while invulnerable and click every button in the pause menu.

value.notes: Round 1, no prior notes. Read the HUD after every tick and compare it with state.timeLeft, lives, dashCooldown and the Dash text. Check timer decrement, dash recharge countdown (6 after a dash, HUD "Dash 5" immediately after), invulnerability countdown after a hit, and pause freezing everything. Watch pause+move in one tick (the rest of the tick must be ignored). Use different seeds to vary enemy timing.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After the dash picks up a coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5' (while Score and Time update correctly).
verdicts.expected: Section 8: the HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Timer change while paused comes from Restart, not a freeze failure
verdicts.observed: The timer goes 299 -> 300 on the tick where Restart is clicked. That change is the restart resetting the level, which the design allows. The real defect is that the game stays paused after restart (candidate 2).
verdicts.expected: Paused state freezes timer and player. A restart legitimately resets the timer to 300, so this check should exempt restart ticks. The symptom is covered by candidate 2.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After clicking Restart level from the pause menu, the level resets (score 0, time 300) but mode stays 'paused' with the pause menu still open, and no move happens until the player resumes.
verdicts.expected: Section 7: Restart level puts the level back to its start and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap the score to 65136 and then negative values
verdicts.observed: Taking spikes at 100 score makes the score 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped as an unsigned 16-bit value). A later coin then shows -300 (65236 read as signed 16-bit). Score is negative and out of range.
verdicts.expected: Section 4: spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes negative. Score stays between 0 and 999,999 and items never reduce it. Expected score after spikes is 0.

verdicts.title: Movement still happens in the tick where pause is pressed
verdicts.observed: Input 'pause+left' pauses the game, but the left step is still applied: the player moves from (6,1) to (5,1) and the events list contains 'move' alongside 'pause'.
verdicts.expected: Section 2: when the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens. The player should stay at (6,1).

verdicts.title: Level-complete bonus banner covers the Finish button
verdicts.observed: In the 'Level complete!' dialog the Finish button (btn-next) is visible but not the topmost element at its centre (top=false), so a click on it is intercepted by the bonus banner.
verdicts.expected: Section 7: every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it. Finish should receive the click and open the victory dialog.

verdicts.title: Dash and step both applied in one tick, moving the player 3 tiles
verdicts.observed: On tick 8, dash-right+up moved the player from (7,3) to (9,2): a dash of 2 tiles right plus a step up. The dash recharge was set to 5, so the dash was used, and the up key was also applied as a move.
verdicts.expected: Of the movement keys pressed in a tick only the last one counts (here 'up'), so the player makes at most one move per tick: a single step to (7,2), or one straight dash of up to two tiles.

verdicts.title: Restart from pause leaves the game paused with no menu, time frozen
verdicts.observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, the state reports mode 'paused' with no dialog or buttons shown. The restart event fired and the level was reset, but 30 subsequent wait ticks did nothing: the timer stayed at 300 and the player did not move.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so the timer should count down and the player should be able to act.

verdicts.title: HUD shows stale coin count (0/5) after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: On tick 1 the state has coins=1 and score=100, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'. It stays at 0/5 on the following tick too, while the score in the HUD is updated.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current values, so after collecting a coin it should read 'Coins 1/5' in the same tick as the score update.

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score to 65136 and later the score goes negative (-300)
verdicts.observed: Hitting spikes with score 100 changed the score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0 (100 - 500 = -400 wraps to 65136 in 16-bit). Later a coin left the score at -300, which is negative.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below. The score must always stay within 0..999,999.

verdicts.title: Key-collected toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: After a key was collected, the 'Key collected' toast stayed visible. When the pause menu opened, btn-resume reported top=false, meaning another element covers it, while btn-restart stayed clickable.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable and nothing may cover it. The Resume button must be on top of the toast.

verdicts.title: Level-complete time bonus wraps score to -32686
verdicts.observed: The score was 30300 before the exit. Completing the level with a time bonus of 2550 should give 32850, but the level-complete dialog and state show score -32686 (32850 - 65536, a 16-bit wrap).
verdicts.expected: Completing the level adds the time bonus to the score. The score must stay between 0 and 999,999, so the result should be 32850.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative on level completion (-32746)
verdicts.observed: At tick 41, stepping onto the exit at (12,7) changes the score from 30200 to -32746 and the HUD shows Score -32746, while the level-complete dialog shows Time bonus +2590. Nothing between ticks 40 and 41 explains a drop of this size.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999. Completing the level should add the time bonus (10 per tick left, here 2590) to the score, giving about 32790, which is in range.
